android.desc:
Build a daily gratitude habit with My Gratitude Jar - a mindfulness journal designed to help you capture life's good moments, track your mood, and rediscover memories that matter.

✨ SHAKE YOUR JAR

Every memory you save goes into your jar. When you're ready, shake your phone to reveal a random moment from your past — a simple, powerful reminder of the good already in your life.

📓 GRATITUDE JOURNALING

Write freely or use guided prompts in your daily gratitude journal. Track your mood, capture moments you never want to forget, and revisit them anytime — organised, searchable, and completely private.

🌿 DAILY AFFIRMATIONS

Receive three fresh affirmations every day. Say them out loud and let the app listen — voice recognition confirms your practice, making it more intentional and impactful.

🌬️ BREATHING EXERCISES

Reset in minutes with guided breathing: Box Breathing, 4-7-8, and Simple. Reduce stress, calm your mind, and feel grounded again.

💬 DAILY QUOTE

Start your day with inspiration. Save your favourite quotes and revisit them whenever you need a lift.

⏰ DAILY REMINDERS

Stay consistent with gentle reminders — because real change comes from small daily actions.

✦ PREMIUM FEATURES
🕰️ MEMORY CAPSULES

Lock memories away and open them in the future — a gift from past you.

📸 PHOTO ATTACHMENTS

Add photos to your entries and bring your memories to life.

🎨 BEAUTIFUL THEMES

Personalise your journal with carefully crafted themes.

☁️ CLOUD BACKUP

Securely sync your entries across devices with Google or email login.

✦ UPGRADE TO PREMIUM

Unlock all features with a monthly or yearly subscription. Cancel anytime.

💡 WHY GRATITUDE WORKS

A consistent gratitude practice can improve mood, reduce stress, support better sleep, and build long-term emotional resilience.

🔒 YOUR PRIVACY MATTERS

Your journal is yours. No ads. No data selling. Everything you write stays private and protected.

📧 devyprabs@gmail.com

My Gratitude Jar — because every good moment deserves to be remembered. ✦
